review_kind: Read-only diagnosis of all three normalization rejections; not scientific acceptance or a counterfactual execution.

final_diagnostic.message: bounded proposal correction or transport retry exhausted

confirmed_findings.finding: Round 1 is an actual outer response-format violation, not a physical-condition contradiction.
confirmed_findings.detail: The raw model content adds top-level type=json_object. The sent system prompt explicitly limits the response to action/parameters/reason; RESPONSE_ENVELOPE lists exactly those keys. The stored rejection is extra_forbidden at [type]. Round 2 removes it.

confirmed_findings.finding: Round 2 retains the single-point comparison in authenticated sources and minimum_evidence, but fails the narrow quantity-coverage representation rule.
confirmed_findings.detail: orca_sp_energy has quantity=绝对能量和相对最低项的kJ/mol排名 at message offsets 188:207, source_refs spanning 23:238, and minimum_evidence=[完成真实ORCA单点能量比较]. The reported obligation is 65:95. energy_quantity checks only its electronic-energy keyword regex and quantity occurrence overlap; it does not credit this minimum_evidence or the enclosing retained source. The quantity lacks the regex terms 电子能/单点能, and its occurrence also lies outside 65:95.
confirmed_findings.classification: runtime semantic representation restriction, not demonstrated loss of the user single-point requirement

confirmed_findings.finding: Round 2 feedback exposes a legacy fixed_initial label that is not the general-Goal geometry requirement used by the actual coverage matcher.
confirmed_findings.detail: _explicit_energy_requests extracts fixed_initial from the 单点 phrase at 1561/1574. That unadjusted obligation is returned at 1624-1630. For a matching general Goal, geometry_matches instead recomputes _general_goal_geometry_relation at 1607-1615. The second proposal fails energy_quantity first, so the absence of fixed_initial was not its decisive failed predicate.
confirmed_findings.classification: misleading runtime diagnostic; not proof that runtime requires an impossible pair of geometry labels

confirmed_findings.finding: Round 3 follows the missing-energy feedback by adding an explicit single-point quantity and fixed_initial, then fails the source-grounded general geometry check.
confirmed_findings.detail: The new goal orca_single_point_energy has quantity=真实ORCA单点能量比较 at 83:95 and source 23:111, plus geometry_relation=fixed_initial. The rejection is only goals[2].geometry_relation with geometry_relation_is_unknown_or_ambiguous_in_user_text. The user requests multiple different conformers and does not restrict the task to one exact initial XYZ. General per-candidate SP therefore has no one fixed_initial relation. The model reason explicitly says it added fixed_initial in response to the prior validation.
confirmed_findings.classification: unsupported model scalar geometry assertion, amplified by misleading preceding feedback

confirmed_findings.finding: The actual prompt contains two conflicting descriptions of fixed_initial for general tasks.
confirmed_findings.detail: generated_task_intent says fixed_initial binds the exact initial/prepared XYZ and single-point operation alone does not establish it, and says not to impose one scalar label on multiple candidates. INTENT_RULES.instruction still says Energy needs its own Goal; fixed_initial=SP, optimized=after Opt without limiting that phrase to legacy scalar goals. Both are present in all three actual requests.
confirmed_findings.classification: prompt inconsistency; geometry_relation JSON enum alone does not encode the source-dependent applicability rule

confirmed_findings.finding: Source fragments and raw response persistence do not explain the observed failure.
confirmed_findings.detail: All referenced source IDs exist in each sent request, every fragment equals its authenticated message slice, each Goal quantity is an exact substring of its referenced retained range, and parsing each raw_content equals its stored proposal. Physical conditions remain neutral/singlet/gas phase across all three rounds. Conditions use quotes without source_refs, so the T1 duplicate whole-fragment equality failure did not occur here.
confirmed_findings.classification: no observed alias/source projection corruption or condition-value contradiction

interpretation.supported: The Run ends before normalization activation after one genuine envelope error and two semantic representation rejections. The major product-side issue is a narrow energy-coverage match with misleading legacy geometry feedback, compounded by contradictory prompt wording. It is not an ORCA, identity, container, or numerical failure.
interpretation.static_inference: A general single-point quantity at the reported source range without an unsupported scalar geometry_relation is compatible with these two specific predicates. This is a code-reading inference only; no edited proposal was submitted and no product validation was replayed.
interpretation.not_established: The review does not prove the entire third proposal, with any change, would pass every other intake, planning, permission, budget, execution, or scientific check. It does not establish successful task completion or replace the seven-task run with a retry.
interpretation.schema_runtime_distinction: Round 1 is consistent envelope enforcement. Rounds 2/3 are dynamic semantic checks not fully represented in the JSON Schema; the evidence specifically establishes misleading diagnostic/prompt semantics, rather than a JSON-schema type/field disagreement.

simplification_suggestions_not_implement: Keep electronic-energy preservation checks, but ground them against the whole authenticated goal/source and explicit minimum evidence; do not force the model to split an already retained same-scope absolute/relative energy comparison only to repeat a particular quantity keyword at a particular occurrence.

Generate missing-energy feedback using the same general or legacy geometry semantics used by the acceptance predicate. A per-candidate single-point obligation should not advertise fixed_initial when that is not its required relation.
Remove or scope the legacy fixed_initial=SP shorthand in the general-task prompt. Keep explicit initial-XYZ/hash constraints and actual per-candidate single-point obligations.

Return the exact failed predicate and smallest applicable representation correction while preserving candidate count, distinctness, real ORCA provenance, units, seed conditions and the finite-search limitation.

source_fragments.text: 请搜索正己烷（中性、单重态、气相）的低能构象。
自行编写本次搜索和筛选程序，实际保存至少8份候选结构，并从中选择至少4个不同的构象，在同一方法、基组和统一计算类型下完成真实ORCA单点能量比较；方法和基组由你选择并说明依据。
请用考虑碳链正反向等价映射的重原子对齐RMSD检查重复，以0.15Å为重复阈值，至少4个参加比较的构象应两两不同。
交付所有实际产生的候选、选中及排除原因、绝对能量和相对最低项的kJ/mol排名、最低候选结构，并说明搜索范围、几何来源以及力场处理是否收敛。
可以使用力场预筛选，但不能把未做ORCA的候选写成已有ORCA能量，也不能把有限搜索最低项称为全局最低或自由能最低。
若结构生成、搜索或其他算法使用随机数，请统一采用种子 1701 并在报告中记录；若某一库或模型不支持固定种子，明确记为不可固定，不伪造确定性。

source_and_schema_as_sent.source_reference_rules: Goals, explicit conditions and automatic_selection authorization may supply source_refs instead of recopying text_basis/message_id. References name authenticated user fragments; the program retains the exact source and any intervening text. Keep quantity as the user's physical quantity phrase. A reference does not prove an arbitrary field value. Exact text_basis remains accepted. Environment values use gas_phase, CPCM(solvent), or SMD(solvent); retain the user's model and solvent. value_basis may identify an exact literal value phrase inside the source. The program records the raw phrase and separately checks the canonical model/solvent mapping; a citation alone is insufficient. The program supplies an omitted unambiguous geometry_relation; conflicting relations remain errors. analysis_goal_ref is only a legacy sampling specification reference, not a general Goal dependency.
source_and_schema_as_sent.generated_task_intent: For a general identity, every scientific Goal uses the general observation contract even if its port name also exists in a legacy qualified Tool. Registered input ports prepared_geometry, resolved_identity retain their input checks. Input Goals omit geometry_relation; preparing initial geometry is not a scientific fixed_initial or optimized result. Every general scientific Goal must supply quantity as an exact user phrase and a stable port identifier chosen for that quantity; absence of a registered property port/checker is not an unresolved user fact. A query explicitly requests existing evidence; a general quantity without query remains a generated observation even when its port spelling also names a read Tool output. Bind every molecular Goal, including report/seed/delivery Goals, to its exact system_refs. Keep requested delivery contents in quantities, Goals and result data; do not turn each content item into an additional scientific minimum_evidence guarantee. Preserve every explicitly demanded scientific minimum. Each nonregistered minimum_evidence entry must copy one contiguous exact user quote, without reordering words, adding a summary, or changing numbers/units. Never delete a requirement to fix its wording. Default verification=reported_with_limitations; qualified requires an explicit user minimum-evidence demand. Preserve geometry_relation only when the user explicitly requires one unambiguous optimized/fixed_initial relation. Ground it in the quantity's own clause; do not apply a calculation's geometry label to unrelated reporting or random-seed Goals. fixed_initial binds the exact initial/prepared XYZ; single-point calculation or fixed internal geometry does not itself establish that binding. A prohibition on optimization is not optimized. General tasks may use multiple candidate/derived geometries. Do not impose one fixed_initial/optimized label on their per-geometry calculations; program source references retain shared geometry constraints without recopying them into every Goal. An explicit initial XYZ/hash restriction still binds. When routine steps are delegated and no scalar relation is specified, omit geometry_relation, choose the program steps within budget and record each source's actual geometry relation; do not require a user SP-versus-Opt choice. Never change an explicit geometry requirement. The program retains explicit units with source references; an absent unit is not proof of compliance. Preserve every requested quantity and genuine ambiguity. Do not declare a molecule unsupported from the legacy_qualified_scope. If the user delegates a condition choice, put its exact authorization in automatic_selection[field]={text_basis,message_id}, omit that field from conditions, and do not mark it unknown/inferred or add a pending-source gap. Then select_conditions before scientific execution; retrieved sources are optional and geometry preparation may precede selection. These are available actions, not missing user answers. When Request.conditions.explain_results=true, final delivery already explains actual conditions and verification; do not create another knowledge_answer Goal for that delivery requirement. knowledge_answer is for independent knowledge questions. identities[].name is exact user text; key binds system_refs; a translated query_name remains an inferred lookup alias. For a non-English name, use a confidently known English lookup alias in query_name; preserve name verbatim. New name queries check one PubChem candidate and its graph/formula/charge, without independently authenticating the original name or translation; do not guess an unknown alias. No identity, port or unauthorized method/basis/spin is filled in by the program.
source_and_schema_as_sent.instruction: Rules:minimum_evidence_rules; queries:query_schemas[port]; [] keeps basic checks. Lexicon lists known spelling aliases, not all permitted values; retain frozen authorized_defaults and exact user wording. Keep unknown/unsupported and explain_results; unknown/inferred belong in conditions/system_conditions. Chemistry questions use knowledge_answer, not energy; no geometry/physical conditions needed. Version/manual/source questions: knowledge.search before knowledge.answer. Energy needs its own Goal; fixed_initial=SP, optimized=after Opt. temperature/standard_state only if requested; absent unit=unknown, no question. Copy pending IDs; verbatim text_basis must match field/target. Same-message repeats bind all positions. normalize replaces raw_request/missing:goal_definition; amend keeps goals; replace_goals needs explicit replacement+all old IDs. NewGoal system_refs; existingGoal goal_bindings[Goal.id]. Registration/no-execution is not a Goal. science_scope describes legacy qualified checks, not general execution or permission/defaults. New target identities: exact name/text_basis/message_id; key binds system_refs. A translated query_name stays inferred; v3 checks the returned candidate, not the translation. General quantity quotes user; verification=reported_with_limitations unless user requires qualified evidence. automatic_selection[field]={text_basis,message_id}: explicit authorization only, not unknown. Select authorized method/basis before scientific execution; sources are optional, reasoning is required. Geometry preparation may precede selection. Never infer spin from parity. resolves=answered field:<field>/system:<goal_id>; question_gaps=questions to gaps.
